name: Pepperoni Pasta Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 6 ounces orzo, cooked and well drained

steps: Combine all of the ingredients in a large bowl and toss well to combine.
Serve warm or chill before serving.

culture.text: Pasta salad, known in Italian as insalata di pasta or pasta fredda, is a dish prepared with one or more types of pasta, almost always chilled or room temperature, and most often tossed in a vinegar, oil or mayonnaise-based dressing. It is typically served as an appetiser (antipasto) or first course.
